programmes.name_en: Oman Technology Fund / ITHCA Group startup investment
programmes.funder: ITHCA Group (Oman Technology Fund), Oman Investment Authority
programmes.amount_note: Direct venture investment into Omani and regional technology companies plus fund commitments. Ticket sizes are negotiated and not published; the earlier Wadi Accelerator and Ignite tracks offered smaller pre-seed cheques.
programmes.deadline_note: ITHCA restructured the Oman Technology Fund's accelerator programmes; direct investment enquiries are handled on a rolling basis.
programmes.reopen_note: The original Oman Technology Fund accelerator tracks (Wadi, Ignite, Sas) were reorganised under ITHCA Group. Early-stage founders in Oman are now generally routed through partner incubators and the Sas programme run with Omantel rather than a standing OTF call.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach ITHCA Group or a partner incubator with the company.

eligibility.other_note: Preference for companies with Omani operations or a commitment to establish them.

programmes.name_local: الهيئة العامة لتنمية المؤسسات الصغيرة والمتوسطة - ريادة
programmes.name_en: Riyada (Authority for Small and Medium Enterprises Development) support services
programmes.funder: Riyada - Authority for Small and Medium Enterprises Development, Oman
programmes.amount_note: Riyada issues the Riyada Card, which unlocks preferential access to government procurement set-asides, subsidised licensing, training and referral to financing schemes such as Al Raffd Fund. Riyada itself does not usually pay cash grants.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling registration for the Riyada Card and associated services.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the business and apply for the Riyada Card.
Apply to linked financing schemes (for example Al Raffd Fund) using the Riyada Card.

eligibility.other_note: Restricted to Omani-owned SMEs meeting Riyada's size thresholds.

programmes.name_en: Sharakah (Fund for Development of Youth Projects)
programmes.funder: Sharakah - Fund for the Development of Youth Projects SAOC
programmes.amount_note: Provides financing (loans and some equity) to Omani youth-owned SMEs, historically in the range of OMR 20,000 to OMR 200,000, together with post-financing mentoring.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit an enquiry and business plan to Sharakah.

eligibility.other_note: Omani nationals, generally young entrepreneurs, with the founder actively managing the business.
